headword: {単純作業|たんじゅんさぎょう}
gloss: simple repetitive work; routine task; menial work

definitions.gloss: simple repetitive work; routine task; menial work
definitions.explanation: Work requiring little thought or skill that involves repeating the same actions.

examples.japanese: {単純作業|たんじゅんさぎょう}が{続|つづ}くと{飽|あ}きる。
examples.english: I get bored when simple repetitive work goes on and on.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}は{単純作業|たんじゅんさぎょう}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This job involves a lot of routine tasks.

examples.japanese: {単純作業|たんじゅんさぎょう}はAIやロボットに{置|お}き{換|か}えられるだろう。
examples.english: Simple repetitive tasks will likely be replaced by AI and robots.

notes:
Work that requires little thought or skill and involves repeating the same actions. A compound of {単純|たんじゅん} (simple) and {作業|さぎょう} (work/task). Often discussed in the context of automation, job satisfaction, or labor markets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単純作業|たんじゅんさぎょう}をこなす: to carry out routine tasks
- {単純作業|たんじゅんさぎょう}の{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し: repeating simple tasks
- {単純作業|たんじゅんさぎょう}を{自動化|じどうか}する: to automate simple tasks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}: manual labor — emphasizes physical effort
- {事務作業|じむさぎょう}: clerical work — desk-based tasks
- {雑務|ざつむ}: miscellaneous duties — odd jobs, not necessarily repetitive
